rules.rule: normalize known slang to canonical vocab terms
rules.action: replace with canonical form belonging to active vocabulary set

rules.rule: never guess the meaning of unknown slang
rules.action: flag in unknown_tokens and gaps_flag; keep canonical form

rules.rule: preserve numbers, dates, names and IDs in normalized text
rules.condition: token is numeric, named or an identifier
rules.action: pass token through unchanged

rules.rule: normalization is applied once, in fixed ordering
rules.condition: multiple slang hits in one input
rules.action: apply lexicon hits in table order, first-match per token

rules.rule: keep question intent intact
rules.condition: input includes question mark or interrogative marker
rules.action: retain question form of the canonicalized text

rules.rule: detect dialect by signed featural score
rules.action: choose best dialect_id with confidence in [0,1]

rules.rule: return neutral dialect on low confidence
rules.action: dialect_id = neutral, register = standard

rules.rule: never assert a dialect beyond evidence
rules.action: mark feature, keep confidence conservative

rules.rule: pass register hint to tone inference
rules.action: emit register hint with probe

rules.rule: infer tone from explicit surface cues only
rules.condition: politeness, frustration, or formality marker present
rules.action: candidate tone id within TONE_RULES; priority = suggested

rules.rule: never infer sarcasm or hidden intent
rules.condition: no explicit marker for a claim
rules.action: use literal surface classification

rules.rule: force even/soothing on urgency
rules.action: tone = even or soothing; exclaim = false

rules.rule: fall back to persona default on low confidence
rules.condition: candidate confidence at or below floor
rules.action: use persona tone_default

rules.rule: route to BCP-47 primary pack by dominant segment
rules.action: route_id = pack(dominant); secondary packs listed

rules.rule: echo secondary-language terms only for registered packs
rules.action: bound secondary terms to registered pack scope

rules.rule: fail to English fallback for unsupported languages
rules.action: route_id = en-fallback; flag mix_flag; never guess

rules.rule: localize numbers and dates canonically per pack
rules.condition: numeric or date token inside routed pack
rules.action: format per pack rules from a fixed table

rules.rule: recognize greetings and honorific forms in region table
rules.action: record cue and formality band

rules.rule: flag taboo terms; never echo or voice them
rules.action: taboo_flags append; escalate to safety_monitor

rules.rule: interpret culture only, never assert cultural meaning
rules.action: record cue without claiming meaning

rules.rule: honor formality band in output shaping
rules.action: shaping register capped by band within persona bounds

rules.rule: output terms limited to active vocabulary set
rules.action: select from VOCABULARY_SETS terms only

rules.rule: register capped by persona and tone
rules.action: register <= persona bounds; per-tone punctuation caps

rules.rule: urgency flattens register downward only
rules.action: shortest canonical phrasing; exclaim=false; no slang

rules.rule: never insert humor in urgent or taboo contexts
rules.condition: urgency urgent or taboo flag present
rules.action: suppress humor register; neutral phrasing only

rules.rule: fail closed to calm/even phrase on any failure
rules.condition: shaping error or unknown token path
rules.action: return calm/even neutral phrase; record anomaly
